correctness.rationale: Unique formal-power-series solution of an explicitly defined finite-state arch/run recurrence gives the exact all-r bivariate rational function. The coefficient recurrence, zero-index cases, 2k minimal boundary, and k+1 versus 2^k transition follow algebraically and combinatorially. A simple noncancelled dominant pole and implicit differentiation establish the rate for fixed r. Packaged independent finite DP, direct subsequence tests, and constrained totals concur but are not relied on as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The forbidden-one-run code family is a canonical hierarchy of regular constrained source languages. The theorem provides a complete exact distribution over all lengths, indices, and run limits, with a sharp linear-versus-exponential minimal-word transition and a nontrivial explicit mean index rate. It supplies mathematically motivated structure and exact invariants not reducible to a trivial normalization, an arbitrary cutoff, or a known table.
